security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' notes-asset: data:; font-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: 'self' http://ipc.localhost; frame-src 'none'; object-src 'none'; form-action 'none'; base-uri 'none'

bundle.longDescription: notes edits Markdown files in a folder you choose. The files on disk are the source of truth: no database, no proprietary format, and every note stays readable from a terminal, an editor or a backup with the application uninstalled.
